Fixed a 10.7x MCCL unaligned AllGather slowdown; total MCCL collective time cut 804.3 ms -> 171.1 ms/iter (-78.7%)

Multi-card offload overhead (~27 ms/block, 55 MiB/ms) was 3x worse than pure-GEMM/norm micro-recompute; disabled
